name: SkateBoots
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game accessory, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms. A single chunky cartoon ice-skate boot for a short round Santa: short stubby rounded boot with a big fluffy fur cuff around the top opening, laces up the front, a small buckle, a thick sole, and a big chunky skate blade underneath that curls up into a round loop at the toe. Left-right symmetrical so it fits either foot. Toy-like proportions, single object, no character, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish. Glossy dark plum-black leather boot, soft cream fur cuff, red-and-white candy-cane striped laces, small shiny gold buckle, thick black sole, shiny bright gold skate blade. Simple bold shapes that read from far away. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: Gear worn over any suit (shared/GearAttach.luau). One Meshy boot used for both feet (symmetrical prompt). Model space = Santa's HumanoidRootPart at the origin, feet 3 studs below, forward -Z (the Meshy boot lies along X with its toe at -X, so yaw -90 turns the toe to -Z). Each boot follows its foot bone via the FollowBone attribute.
